roles.name: Blueprint reconciler
roles.mission: Compare canonical mobile spec, architecture, issue #16 and actual main; produce requirement-to-file/issue trace.
roles.acceptance: Evidence-backed discrepancy matrix; no assumptions from stale checkboxes

roles.name: Dependency and build mapper
roles.mission: Inspect Expo 57, Node >=22.13, CI, EAS config and branch divergence; map version and signing blockers.
roles.acceptance: Exact version/config evidence, no secret exposure

roles.name: NETIZENS backend investigator
roles.mission: Read-only map dedicated Supabase project, migrations, RLS/grants and known effective timestamps.
roles.acceptance: No migration replay or cross-project connection

roles.name: Security adversary
roles.mission: Challenge access and data-leak hypotheses across Citizen, public discussion, Circle, DM, blocked users.
roles.acceptance: Reproducible tests, not unverified claims

roles.name: Citizen identity engineer
roles.mission: Repair permanent-Citizen signup/onboarding/session recovery edge cases against canonical backend.
roles.acceptance: Auth regression tests, no anonymous World access

roles.name: World/navigation engineer
roles.mission: Finish World→Place→Entity and parent navigation, cached-first screens and authorized deep links.
roles.acceptance: No private content leak; no Perception on social path

roles.name: Participation/outbox engineer
roles.mission: Fix idempotent offline join/post/reply retries, terminal RLS rejection and account switching.
roles.acceptance: Stable mutation ID and no duplicate canonical writes

roles.name: Push registration engineer
roles.mission: Implement authenticated persistent push token lifecycle, replacements, logout revoke and delivery failure handling.
roles.acceptance: Server evidence needed before delivery claims

roles.name: Notification/deep-link engineer
roles.mission: Build notification response routing to authorized entity and background/terminated handling.
roles.acceptance: Actual iOS/Android arrival remains separate acceptance

roles.name: Safety UI engineer
roles.mission: Complete report/block controls with canonical server-authorized states and appeal/review boundaries.
roles.acceptance: No automatic sanctions or unreviewed allegations

roles.name: Private messaging isolation engineer
roles.mission: Audit DM/Circle request-consent, server RLS, cached private data and blocked-recipient enforcement.
roles.acceptance: No Circle/DM messages in public entity discussion

roles.name: College funnel engineer
roles.mission: Persist College Groups impression→open→join→participate→return→cross-campus events with retry-safe IDs.
roles.acceptance: Seeded/demo/test excluded from genuine counts

roles.name: Local discovery engineer
roles.mission: Finish true local-area filtering and context permissions without revealing precise location.
roles.acceptance: Optional permission and denied-permission fallback

roles.name: Performance engineer
roles.mission: Instrument five speed budgets and raw device sample capture without delaying social paths.
roles.acceptance: No synthetic production-performance claims

roles.name: Accessibility and UX reviewer
roles.mission: Test screen reader labels, touch targets, contrast, reduced motion and denied permission flows.
roles.acceptance: Evidence linked to exact build; design source preserved

roles.name: Offline and crash test engineer
roles.mission: Exercise process termination, rejected writes, offline replay, stale tokens and account switches.
roles.acceptance: Repeatable test output plus canonical-record checks

roles.name: Database/RLS validator
roles.mission: Run authorized two-account allow/deny scenarios and DB fixture regressions.
roles.acceptance: Read-only first; changes approved separately

roles.name: iOS physical-device tester
roles.mission: Collect signed iOS build/install, push, deep-link, speed and auth evidence from a real phone.
roles.acceptance: Apple developer/signing membership may block

roles.name: Android physical-device tester
roles.mission: Collect signed Android build/install, push, deep-link, speed and auth evidence from a real phone.
roles.acceptance: New artifact must contain current source

roles.name: Independent integration auditor
roles.mission: Cross-check test results, repository diffs, staged build and proof ledger; challenge optimistic reports.
roles.acceptance: Never close issue #16 from code/CI alone

roles.name: Release readiness owner
roles.mission: Assemble private-beta evidence matrix and identify exact remaining user-complete blockers.
roles.acceptance: No publication, production deployment, DNS or signing spend

roles.name: Perception integration architect
roles.mission: Maintain optional bounded bridge; verify tasks/grants/receipts only against real runtime interfaces.
roles.acceptance: Do not create duplicate Perception or force AI into social critical path

roles.name: Continuous integration engineer
roles.mission: Strengthen relevant tests/checks and record exact source SHA and job outcome.
roles.acceptance: Passing bundles cannot substitute for phone verification

roles.name: Contradiction and provenance reviewer
roles.mission: Compare observed outputs against the blueprint and sources, detect stale or conflicting claims.
roles.acceptance: Separate verified, unverified, stale, blocked and failed
